prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production eight-frame looping desktop pet run animation, transparent PNG sprite sheet.
Input: approved Miku drawing as the exact identity, style, proportions and viewpoint reference. Keep the same cute turquoise-haired Miku, same open eyes, face, twin-tail shape, red/black headset, light gray vest with turquoise tie, black detached sleeves, pleated skirt and thigh-high black boots. Only articulate the limbs for animation.
Create exactly EIGHT distinct consecutive frames, four columns by two rows, identical SQUARE cells, reading left to right top row then bottom row. This is ONE smooth run cycle toward screen RIGHT. All drawings must use the exact same head size, torso length, shoulder position and near/far limb lengths. No camera rotation, no zoom, no horizontal displacement, only a gentle small vertical bob. Full character centered in each cell with at least 7% completely transparent margin on every edge. Hair may gently follow the run but stays within its cell.
Critical correction: both elbows remain naturally bent approximately 90 degrees in ALL frames. Both upper arms and forearms have fixed short chibi lengths. Hands remain close to torso, below chin. NO outstretched straight arm, NO reaching or punch, NO suddenly long sleeve, NO giant fist. Only modest rotation at shoulders and knees, with clear opposite arm/leg swing. Each arm stays attached to its own shoulder, exactly two arms and two hands per character.
Cycle:
1 near leg forward contact, far leg back; near arm bent BACK beside hip, far arm bent forward beside chest.
2 compress downward gently, same near leg taking weight; arms move slightly toward neutral.
3 passing: far knee passes near leg, near hand comes toward the waist, far hand lowers.
4 flight into opposite stride: far leg extending forward, near knee bends back; near bent arm swings FORWARD across lower chest, far bent arm back.
5 far leg forward contact, near leg back; near arm naturally bent forward across chest, far arm bent backward beside hip.
6 compress gently on far leg; arms begin modest return.
7 passing: near knee passes far leg; both hands near waist.
8 flight into initial stride: near leg extends forward, far knee bends back; near arm swings back bent beside hip, far bent arm swings toward chest. Frame 8 transitions smoothly back into frame 1.
The foreground leg must switch between frames 1 and 5; do not draw the same foreground leg forward throughout. The foreground arm must clearly alternate between back and front, never stay fixed. Use consistent linework, no pose-dependent limb stretching, no fully straight horizontal sleeves. No text, borders, grid lines, particles, duplicate appendages, detached sprite fragments or background. Use clean antialiased alpha without neon edge specks.
reason: The eight-frame redraw did not exchange the foreground arm and leg as required. Retained the independently approved opposing arm poses instead.
